protocol.order: Rotated arm order by task/repetition; reversed alternating rows
protocol.quality: All independent behavior and protected-source checks; real CPU elapsed time <=85% baseline with >=7/9 paired wins, stress speedup >=0.9; horizontal construction slowdown <=4; actual changed source required
protocol.measurements: 9 serial four-pass ABBA/BAAB timing blocks on unchanged actual geometry, paired means; stress separate; no whole-game FPS claim
protocol.public_checks: Fixed project_checks tool identical in every arm; three-city short smoke, different fuzz seed from final
protocol.chunking: Unit; overlapping UTF-8 windows 768/128 bytes; AST groups bounded to 768 plus compiler-bound dependencies and scope signatures
protocol.artifact_isolation: No .code-memory files in agent workspaces; B plugin reads its frozen projection externally and observes exact source through the workspace filesystem
protocol.limitation: Two related optimization types in one project, three stochastic repeats; AST scope enrichment changes with granularity
